name: email-archive
description: Archive an email by removing it from the inbox. Use for emails that need no action — receipts, newsletters, automated notifications. Silently moves the message out of INBOX.

inputs.message_id: string (Nylas message ID of the email to archive)
inputs.account: string? (named account to archive from, as configured under Settings → Channels → Email → Email accounts. Defaults to the primary account if omitted.)

outputs.archived: boolean — true when the message was successfully archived
